title: coffeeshop / cafe - boarded up
content: i’ve been trying to visit a coffeeshop / cafe in my mall world dreams for as long as i can remember (15/20+ years) - if anything it feels like the ONLY thing i am ever trying to do in mallworld the coffeeshop has been there ever since my first mallworld dream, it even changed to a vegan cafe when i went vegan 11 years ago, i am always trying to get there so i can order a slice of chocolate fudge cake, as soon as i get to the mall i know exactly where it is and every dream i have there seems to have the overriding theme of i need to get to the coffeeshop - over the span of the past 15+ years ive managed to get there, stand in line, order, pay & receive my cake - dream by dream i’ve been getting close to finally eating it the first dream i had after i got to the final stage of actually having the cake in my hand, i returned back to the cafe and it was completely boarded up - this was a few years ago now since then every mallworld dream i try and get back there , but i still haven’t been able to do it - i honestly feel like something so significant is connected to this but i don’t know what anyone else experienced this or had any ideas? THE CAFE - it’s right at the end of the mall (opposite side to the train station), it’s on the outside of the building in a row of other shops - the end shop is a souvenir shop and the coffeeshop is a few doors down to the left. if you keep going left you get to a metal spiral type outdoor staircase that leads to a few floors above. it’s quite small, bar to the right as you walk in with a few tables to the left. now it’s closed it is covered in wooden slats across the window and door nailed in. thanks !!
